title: The etale diagonal base-change factor in coefficient-unit coordinates
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring and f:X→Y a compactifiable, separated, quasi-compact etale map between Noetherian schemes. Use the compact-support comparison coordinates of [def-pur-finite-smooth-comparison-coordinates]. For every comparison family C satisfying its graph and homotopy normalization, finiteSmoothDiagonalFactor A f followed by finiteSmoothSectionCoordinates A C (p₁,Delta) equals finiteSmoothOmegaCoordinates A C f. This compares only the exceptional diagonal factor and requires no deformation geometry, annihilating exponent, bundle integration, or supplied orientation.

source.place: First factor of the displayed three-factor orientation; rank-zero calculation in lem-pur-finite-smooth-gamma-normalization, Steps 1 and 3.

proof.text: Identify the supplied comparison with the constructed graph comparison: its sheaf normalization is unique after the monomorphism to direct image, and its homotopy normalization determines its derived inverse. Transport the support-exchange identity for the base change of f along f to the right adjoints. The two adjunction triangles identify the resulting right mate with inverse-image composition.

Evaluate at the coefficient unit and pull back by the diagonal. Naturality moves the unit comparison across the section compositor. The equation Delta followed by p₂ = id cancels that compositor and leaves precisely the claimed coefficient-unit equality.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtaleDiagonalCoordinates
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] [Etale f]
    (C : FiniteSmoothCompactSupportComparisons A)
    (hC : FiniteSmoothComparisonNormalized A C) :
    finiteSmoothDiagonalFactor A f ≫
        (finiteSmoothSectionCoordinates A C (pullback.fst f f) (pullback.diagonal f)).hom =
      (finiteSmoothOmegaCoordinates A C f).hom
